title: Reverse an array
description: Given an array of integers, reverse its order. [1,2,3] -> [3,2,1].
hints: Use i from 0 and j from length-1
Swap arr[i] and arr[j] using temp
solutionExplanation: Elements are swapped from the ends toward the center.

title: Count unique values in a sorted array
description: Count unique values in a sorted array without creating a new array.
hints: The first one is always unique
solutionExplanation: Sorted array: duplicates are adjacent. If datos[i] != datos[i-1], it is a new one.

title: Rotate array N positions to the right
description: Rotate an array N positions to the right. [1,2,3,4,5] rotated 2 -> [4,5,1,2,3].
hints: Save arr[length-1], shift all elements to the right, arr[0] = temp
Use posiciones % length for larger rotations
solutionExplanation: Each rotation saves the last element, shifts everything to the right, and places temp in [0].
